name: Default
shortDescription: End-to-end encrypted password manager with built-in email aliases, bundling the web app, API, admin panel and PostgreSQL in one container.

alerts.message: HTTPS is required: the web app only works from a secure origin, and the mobile apps need a publicly trusted certificate.

The admin panel has no password by default. Open the aliasvault container terminal, run `aliasvault reset-admin-password`, copy the printed password and restart the app; then sign in at /admin as admin.
Anyone can register while PUBLIC_REGISTRATION_ENABLED is true. Set it to false after creating your accounts; further users can join through invite links from the admin panel.
SMTP ports 25 and 587 are not published, so aliases use the public email domains. Receiving mail on your own domain needs those ports, MX records and PRIVATE_EMAIL_DOMAINS.
